sections.label: Start here
sections.title: Start with the Office of Undergraduate Research
sections.intro: OUR is UCF's home base for undergraduate research. If you're new to research, start here before emailing anyone.

links.title: Meet a peer mentor
links.description: Students who already do research. Drop in or book through myKnightSTAR; the page has the hours and steps.

callout.title: The OUR research positions database
callout.body: OUR keeps its own list of faculty research positions. It is for UCF students only, and faculty contact details are protected on purpose. You get access by attending a How to: Get Started in Undergraduate Research workshop or meeting with an OUR peer mentor. KnightMatch never copies this database.

sections.label: Credit and pay

links.title: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship
links.description: Spend a summer on your own project with a faculty mentor, ending in a poster presentation.
